sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report details unauthorized card-not-present transactions involving customer C07212 and card C07212-K2. On November 9, 2016 at 02:28:40 UTC, online transaction 3442995 was executed for $150.04 in billing region 325 for product H. The transaction was conducted using device D007351, identified by the profile SM-J327T1 Build/NRD90M on Android 7.0 running Chrome 65.0, which was recorded as new to card C07212-K2. The transaction utilized an anonymous email address from domain anonymous.com. Internal graph analysis established that device D007351 is linked to organized fraud ring 34603052 and was previously confirmed fraudulent in closed cases CC-5527 and CC-5533. Shared origin analytics demonstrated that device D007351 exhibited a 48.43 lift over baseline across multiple unrelated accounts within a seven-day window. Within 24 hours of the alert, device D007351 was also used to conduct concurrent ~$150 product H purchases on connected cards C01629-K1 (transaction 3440243) and C11309-K1 (transaction 3442910). The cardholder baseline for C07212-K2 shows no history with this device, product, or online channel. Additionally, card C07212-K2 has a record of prior compromise across 20 confirmed fraud cases, including CC-5532 and CC-5419. The total fraudulent exposure identified for this transaction is $150.04. Card C07212-K2 was blocked and connected cards were placed on monitoring to prevent further ring exploitation.

stop_reason: The investigation stopped pursuant to Section 6 because the fraud probability reached 0.95 based on multiple independent lines of decisive evidence, including device membership in confirmed fraud ring 34603052, prior confirmed fraud cases CC-5527 and CC-5533, high model scoring (0.90), and concurrent unauthorized transactions on connected cards C01629-K1 and C11309-K1.
